description: US SNAP federal regulations and the dated figures they read. Authoritative source snapshots for the RuleWeaver golden fixture.

rights.basis: US government works and edicts — federal regulations, Federal Register documents and FNS memoranda are not subject to copyright.

retrieval.note: eCFR blocks automated browser access and directs programmatic use to this API. Do not scrape the HTML site.

sources.title: Determining household eligibility and benefit levels

sources.citation: USDA FNS, SNAP – Fiscal Year 2026 Cost-of-Living Adjustments, memo of 13 Aug 2025
sources.title: Maximum allotments, income eligibility standards and deductions, 1 Oct 2025 to 30 Sep 2026
sources.retrieval_note: fns.usda.gov refused automated access; this is the same signed FNS memo as redistributed by the Alaska Department of Health. Check it against the copy published by FNS before relying on it.

sources.citation: HHS, Annual Update of the HHS Poverty Guidelines, 90 FR 5917 (17 Jan 2025), FR Doc. 2025-01377
sources.title: 2025 Poverty Guidelines

verification: sha256sum each file and compare against its sha256 field; tests/test_snap_tables.py re-reads every value from these files.
quotes: A quote in a parameter value is the row as printed in the text file, with runs of whitespace collapsed to one space.
